relations.statement: Mark2.toDatum is a bijection from the two marks onto the two data of the first separation regime
relations.hypotheses: none beyond the first separation regime

relations.statement: The all-pairs requirement list for n data has length n*n
Only the admit operation changes n among the six pre-generation operations

lemmas.statement: Declared rule: each stage change S(n) to S(n+1) is accompanied by exactly one demand-ledger row recording a challenge import, either fresh datum or new requirement kind. This is a definition and a budgeting policy, and no derivation of sufficiency is claimed.
lemmas.lean_skeleton:
structure ImportRow where kind : Bool

def OneImportPerStage (ledger : List ImportRow) (stages : Nat) : Prop := ledger.length = stages

near_misses.claim: One import per level suffices to reach any later stage, or the harness can generate the next demand endogenously
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: BOTTLENECK: declared budgeting policy only, with no endogenous demand generator; OB-1 stays open

open_obligations: No existing declaration grounds the demand ledger or the one-import rule; the ledger type needs to be proposed new
Link between the admit gate and the import row is unproved
Pricing of the import is not formalised
